# Remove-ZbxTemplateGroup

## SYNOPSIS

Removes template groups.

## SYNTAX

```
Remove-ZbxTemplateGroup [-InputObject] <ZabbixReference<ZabbixTemplateGroup>[]> [-Force] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

A template group is a named set of templates; permissions select templates by their groups. The Remove-ZbxTemplateGroup cmdlet deletes the template groups given to -InputObject (names, ids or piped objects) with templategroup.delete, all in one call when the pipeline ends. It asks for confirmation first unless -Confirm:$false or -Force is given, and -WhatIf lists what would be deleted. It writes nothing, and needs a connection made with Connect-ZbxServer.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Delete a template group

```powershell
Remove-ZbxTemplateGroup -InputObject 'Templates/Databases' -Confirm:$false
```

Deletes the template group Templates/Databases. -Confirm:$false skips the prompt the command shows by default.

### Example 2: Preview deleting the template groups a search finds

```powershell
Get-ZbxTemplateGroup -Name 'Templates*' | Remove-ZbxTemplateGroup -WhatIf
```

Lists the template groups whose names start with Templates that the command would delete, and deletes nothing.
